lines.zh: 贴着墙根走，影子跟着我。
lines.en: I hug the wall and the shadow follows me.
Keep the steps light; do not snap the grass.
I slip around the market awnings.

lines.zh: 这条巷子我熟，闭眼也能走。
lines.en: I know this alley well enough to walk it blind.
Faster now, the guard just passed.

lines.zh: 我把兜帽压低，混进人群。
lines.en: Hood low, I melt into the crowd.
Heel first, and it makes no sound.
I duck under the wagon and come out the far side.
That roadside ditch can hide a man.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边数着窗户。
lines.en: Walking, I count the windows.
Bent low, so no one sees my head.
On cobbles I keep to the outer edge.
This road is safer by night.
I cross the puddle without a splash.
Around this street and I reach the back door.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上偷偷跟着。
lines.en: My shadow sneaks along the wall beside me.
I crouch under the eaves and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 手指在袖里摸着那把刀。
lines.en: Inside my sleeve my fingers find the knife.
The street is too quiet. Something is off.
I count the patrol: four of them.
This door's lock is old.
I lean on a barrel, playing the tired traveler.
Empty pockets. A poor day.
I coil the rope I lifted.
The bell rang. One quarter hour left.
I wet a finger and test the wind.
The gutter drips onto my shoulder.
I am waiting for that house to put out its lamp.
Someone coughed behind the door. Hold still.
I scrape the mud off my boots.
A cat watches from the wall. I ignore it.
My hands itch, but tonight I hold back.
What exactly did you see?
Do not shout. Shouting will not help you.
You go your way and I go mine.
Your purse hangs far too loose.
I am not the sort you take me for.
Are you following me?
Watch the road, not me.
There is nothing in my hands.
Call the watch and I run.
This street does not welcome new faces.
I smile and step backward.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了城外的土。
lines.en: There is out-of-town dirt on your boots.
Whoever cut me, I have your face.
I clamp my side; blood leaks between my fingers.

lines.zh: 腰上挨了一下，血是热的。
lines.en: Something hit my side, and the blood is warm.
It hurts, but I will not die in the street.
My cuff has gone dark with blood.
I grit my teeth and slide into the alley.

lines.zh: 骨头可能裂了，我还在跑。
lines.en: The bone may be cracked. I am still running.

lines.zh: 背上一道口子，火辣辣的。
lines.en: A gash across my back burns.
I spit blood and laugh.
I should have dodged that.
Nobody is watching that stall.
The silver glints painfully under the lamp.
I swallow, but my hands itch worse.
That cloth could be mine in one motion.

lines.zh: 钱袋的声音我听得出来。
lines.en: I can hear the weight of that purse.

lines.zh: 我假装看货，眼睛在别处。
lines.en: I pretend to browse and look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这香味来自烤炉，也是机会。
lines.en: That smell comes from an oven, and ovens mean crowds.
I am not hungry. I want it.
The stallkeeper has turned away.
Three seconds is all I need.
Too conspicuous. Not tonight.
My fingers are halfway out already.
That basket of fruit sits right by the door.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，会被人记住。
lines.en: Stare longer and I will be remembered.
I feel the hook in my pocket.

lines.zh: 拿一半，留一半，没人发现。
lines.en: Half for me, half left behind, nobody the wiser.
I pull my hat low and slip around you.
Keep your hand off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 撞一下而已，别大惊小怪。
lines.en: Just a bump. No need for drama.
I step away and act like nothing happened.
You truly do not look ahead.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我的帽子碰掉了。
lines.en: That knock cost me my hat.
Move. I am in a hurry.
Who is that behind you?
I slide past along the wall.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，你是想找麻烦。
lines.en: That close means you want trouble.
She says I will be caught one day.
We split the take in the cellar.
Her fingers are quicker than mine.
She draws the guard off for me.

lines.zh: 我送她一枚偷来的戒指。
lines.en: I give her a ring I stole.
Two of us work it, and we split even.

lines.zh: 她笑起来像在盘算什么。
lines.en: Her laugh always sounds like a plan.
We sit shoulder to shoulder on the roof.
She scolds me and I am glad of it.
By daylight we never walk together.
A silver coin rolled to my foot.

lines.zh: 我把那把汤匙揣进袖子。
lines.en: That spoon goes up my sleeve.
This chain is still sound.
Half a cheese dropped on the ground.

lines.zh: 我顺手把面包塞进怀里。
lines.en: I tuck the bread into my coat.
A key. Worth keeping.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指来路不明，正合适。
lines.en: A ring of unknown origin. Just my sort.

lines.zh: 我掐断线头，把扣子收好。
lines.en: I snap the thread and pocket the button.
A little bag of salt is wedged in the wall.
Whatever I find, I hide it first.

lines.zh: 那个胖子把钱袋挂在外头。
lines.en: That fat one wears his purse outside his coat.
Him. He walks slowly.
His back is turned. Good.

lines.zh: 我盯上了他腰上那串钥匙。
lines.en: My eyes are on the keys at his waist.
That one walks the night road alone.
I have his route memorized.
The mark has stopped at the alley mouth.
That cloak bulges. There is something in it.
No rush. I wait for the turn.
That one, the one with silver clasps.
I shadow him across two streets.
He looks back; I study my shoes.
He quickens; so do I.
He went inside. I wait outside.
I am figuring when he will stop.
This alley ends blind. Good.
My hand is already at my cuff.
He stopped to tie his boot.
I slow my breathing.
Ten more steps and I move.
My short blade slides in at his waist.
I shoulder into him from behind.
My point cuts his purse strings.
He turns; I strike his wrist first.
One slash across his forearm.
I kick the back of his knee and he drops.
The knife skids along the bone.
He grabs my sleeve; I cut myself free.
My elbow cracks his jaw.
Step back, then send the blade forward.

lines.zh: 我从集市的人群里冒出来。
lines.en: I come up out of the market crowd.
Another man with no known past.
I pat the knife inside my sleeve.
Dark enough now. Here I am.

lines.zh: 我在巷口站住，看了看四周。
lines.en: I stop at the alley mouth and look around.
New-stolen boots. They fit well.
There is always a place for me under the wall.
I pull my cap down low.
This town looks wealthy.
I slip into the evening market's flow.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我打滚。
lines.en: Fire caught my sleeve and I rolled.
The roof was slick and I came down.

lines.zh: 脏水灌进鼻子，我呛得慌。
lines.en: Foul water up my nose; I choke.

lines.zh: 那声轰响把我扔进木箱堆。
lines.en: The blast threw me into a pile of crates.
An arrow pinned me to the wooden door.
Something strange has locked my legs.
A heavy purse, and no strength in my legs.

lines.zh: 闪光打中我，我闻到焦味。
lines.en: The flash hit me; I smell burning.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我掉进没底的黑。
lines.en: The floor gives and I drop into bottomless dark.
